jobs.title: Quality and Compliance Writer/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented  Quality and Compliance Writer/Project Coordinator  to lead the development, maintenance, and publication of company policies and procedures across multiple operational departments. This role is primarily focused on policy writing and governance—ensuring policies are clear, current, adopted by process owners, and effectively implemented across the organization.
 The ideal candidate will also bring a solid working understanding of ISO and CMMI and how these frameworks relate to operational controls, documentation, and audit readiness. This role emphasizes how compliance with policy is established, communicated, and sustained across departments (e.g., IT, security, HR, operations, project teams). The position requires autonomy, discipline, strong stakeholder communication, and critical thinking, with experience using AI tools in the workplace to improve the quality and efficiency of documentation work.
 Primary Focus Areas (Estimated) 
 Policy Governance & Policy Writing Drafting, editing, publishing, maintaining, and improving company policies/procedures
 Coordinating reviews/approvals, version control, and periodic policy refresh cycles
 Driving adoption and implementation with operational departments
 Managing document updates and control with multiple stakeholders across departments
 Dayton, OH location preferred. Preference will be given to East Coast candidates based on business need. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the end-to-end policy lifecycle: draft, write, edit, format, publish, and maintain company policies and procedures, including version control and periodic reviews
 Partner with department leads and process owners to collect inputs, clarify responsibilities, and ensure policies reflect how work is actually performed
 Drive policy compliance and adoption by coordinating approvals, communicating updates, and supporting implementation across operational departments
 Translate compliance requirements into practical, usable policies that align to business needs and applicable frameworks (including ISO and CMMI)
 Develop and maintain supporting documentation (e.g., standards, procedures, templates, guidance) to enable consistent execution of policies
 Occasionally support ISO/CMMI-related audit readiness by ensuring policy documentation and evidence expectations are well-organized and aligned to requirements
 Apply critical thinking to identify gaps, risks, and inconsistencies; recommend improvements and corrective actions
 Communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels; track action items and follow through to closure
 Leverage AI tools appropriately to support drafting, editing, summarization, and process/document optimization (in alignment with company guidelines)
 Required Skill Set 
 Strong experience in professional writing, editing, and document control—especially policy and procedure writing (2-5 years)
 Experience policy writing in a government contracting organization a huge plus (2+ years)
 Working knowledge/experience with organizational policy compliance (how policies are implemented, monitored, and reinforced across departments) (2+ years)
 Experience supporting or working within ISO and/or CMMI environments (audit readiness, documentation, quality processes, or process improvement) (1-3 years)
 Ability to work autonomously with a high degree of discipline, prioritization, and attention to detail
 Strong stakeholder communication skills: gather requirements, resolve ambiguity, and drive timely reviews/approvals
 Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; ability to evaluate processes and recommend practical improvements
 Experience utilizing AI in the workplace to improve efficiency and quality of written deliverables (e.g., drafting, rewriting, summarizing, formatting)
 Proficiency with office suite tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); comfort working in collaborative document environments
 Qualifications 
 Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship 
 2-5 years policy and process governance, compliance documentation, or quality management strongly preferred
 ISO/CMMI experience are a plus; training can be provided for the right candidate
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
 Project coordination experience highly desired 
 Employment Details 
 Supportive, collaborative work environment with a focus on professional growth
 Competitive compensation dependent on experience and skills
 About Us 
 Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is a Navajo Nation–owned family of companies that provides government agencies and commercial organizations with high-quality IT, professional, environmental, and research and development services. DDC is dedicated to empowering the Navajo Nation and the communities we serve.
 Benefits 
 Eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, retirement savings with company match, and paid time off. Additional benefits include voluntary supplemental benefits, access to an employee assistance program, and educational assistance with tuition reimbursement.

Job Description Summary 
As related customer equipment, facilities or infrastructure projects: responsible for project delivery, profit & loss accountability, and customer satisfaction through management of project related activities and resources. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness etc.). 
 Job Description

 Formal coursework in project management and experience in construction or working with the building trades.

jobs.title: Portfolio Implementation Associate
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With: 
 Private Wealth Portfolio Management Group is responsible for implementing investment strategies across our private client portfolios. As our business continues to grow and client needs become increasingly sophisticated, the team plays an important role in ensuring portfolios are implemented accurately and efficiently while incorporating client-specific requirements, including tax considerations and customization. 
 The Portfolio Management Group works closely with Portfolio Managers, Trading, Operations, Sales, and other teams across the organization to translate investment decisions into client portfolio. 
 What You'll Do: 
 We are looking for a Portfolio Implementation Associate to join our Private Wealth Portfolio Management Group (PMG) in New York, NY. 
 Responsibilities include portfolio construction and implementation, monitoring asset exposures and allocations, managing client-specific requests, tax management, pre-trade guideline monitoring, and resolving portfolio exceptions. 
 Portfolio Implementation Associates develop a deep understanding of AB's investment products, portfolio management processes, and operational infrastructure while gaining hands-on experience managing portfolios in a fast-paced investment environment. 
 Specific Responsibilities 
 Implement investment decisions across individual equity portfolios. 
 Monitor portfolio positioning, trade execution, cash levels, and compliance with client-specific investment guidelines. 
 Manage client requests and portfolio events throughout the account lifecycle, including cash flows, transitions, account openings, and account closures. 
 Support a high volume of portfolio activity and client specific requests while maintaining strong attention to accuracy, risk management, and client outcomes. 
 Partner with Senior Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Legal/Compliance, Sales, Trading, and Investment Operations/Accounting. 
 Participate in projects focused on portfolio implementation, new and evolving investment capabilities, technology and automation, scalability, and process improvement. 
 Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, controls, and portfolio implementation workflows. 
 What We're Looking For: 
 Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, liberal arts, or a related field. 
 2 - 4 years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or a related financial-services role preferred. 
 Experience supporting U.S. equities, portfolio implementation, or investment-product processes is a plus. 
 A technical background or experience working with data and analytical tools, such as AI Tools, SQL and Power BI, is helpful. 
 A strong interest in financial markets, investment management, and portfolio construction. 
 Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate portfolios and identify potential issues. 
 Excellent attention to detail and a strong risk-management mindset. 
 The ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a deadline-driven environment. 
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across the organization. 
 The ability to think holistically, understand end-to-end processes, and challenge existing approaches when appropriate. 
 A proactive, inquisitive mindset and willingness to take ownership of new challenges. 
 An interest in using technology and automation to improve investment and operational processes. 
 About AB 
 We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.
 Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary 
 The Project Manager leads cross-functional internal projects across Diné Development Corporation (DDC) and its subsidiaries, with an initial focus on Innovation, Growth, and Marketing. Reporting to the Program Manager, this experienced individual contributor translates business priorities into actionable plans and drives assigned projects from initiation through implementation and closeout. This role requires strong project management skills, and the ability to secure follow-through from stakeholders without direct supervisory authority.  
 The role supports initiatives that advance new capabilities, strengthen growth operations, and deliver marketing priorities. The Project Manager coordinates business owners, technical specialists, and vendors to deliver agreed outcomes, support adoption, and measure results. The Program Manager establishes portfolio priorities and provides escalation support; department leaders retain ownership of business decisions, functional resources, and deliverable approval.  
 Core Responsibilities   
 Project Leadership and Delivery  
 Lead multiple assigned projects through scope definition, planning, execution, monitoring, rollout, and closeout, using PMO standards and an approach appropriate to each project.  
 Partner with sponsors and business owners to define objectives, deliverables, acceptance criteria, roles, resource needs, and measurable business benefits before work begins.  
 Build and maintain integrated project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans; track approved budgets and vendor deliverables where applicable.  
 Facilitate kickoffs, working sessions, and decision discussions; establish clear ownership and due dates, resolve delivery barriers, and escalate unresolved risks or resource conflicts with recommended actions.  
 Manage risks, issues, decisions, and scope changes; assess schedule, cost, and resource impacts and obtain required approvals before changing project commitments.  
 Provide concise status reports that explain progress, business impact, upcoming milestones, and decisions needed. Maintain accurate project records in approved PMO tools.  
 Coordinate testing, stakeholder acceptance, training, communications, and operational handoffs with responsible teams. Confirm readiness for launch and track agreed benefits after implementation.  
 Innovation Growth and Marketing Projects  
 Innovation\AI: Lead projects that advance new capabilities, technology adoption, and operational improvements, coordinating requirements, implementation, and adoption with technical teams and business owners.  
 Growth: Lead projects that strengthen business development, capture, and proposal operations, coordinating process improvements, tools, and cross-functional handoffs to support growth objectives.  
 Marketing: Lead projects that support marketing priorities, brand visibility, and stakeholder engagement, coordinating deliverables, approvals, vendors, and implementation with Marketing and supporting teams.  
 PMO and Related Support  
 Improve practical PMO templates and delivery practices, capture lessons learned and help project teams use consistent planning and reporting methods.  
 Provide limited Quality, audit, or policy coordination support when assigned by the Program Manager and aligned with project capacity. Quality and designated subject matter experts retain technical direction, findings, and compliance determinations.  
 Qualifications and Requirements     
 Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship

 Oxford is looking for a Delivery Coordinator to own change orders for a delivery pod and to run CAT 1 engagements alongside the team.  Today, your engagement work is limited to CAT 1 because of experience, not as a permanent ceiling.  Communicate deliverable quality and timeliness against contract and client expectations on the CAT 1 engagements you work.

 Track time, expenses, and budget consumption across the pod’s engagements.
 Coordinate consultant onboarding and offboarding across the pod.
 Coordinate engagement team training activities across the pod.
 Attend the daily standup and keep the Delivery Lead current on change order and CAT 1 status.

 Build toward CAT 2 and CAT 3 readiness as experience and capacity allow.

The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S. and has supported over 20,000 healthcare professionals and team members with close to1,500 health and wellness offices across 50 states in four distinct categories: dental care, urgent care, medical aesthetics, and animal health. Working in partnership with independent practice owners and clinicians, the team is united by a single purpose: to prove that healthcare can be better and smarter for everyone. TAG provides a comprehensive suite of centralized business support services that power the impact of five consumer-facing businesses: Aspen Dental, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers, WellNow Urgent Care, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet (formerly AZPetVet). Each brand has access to a deep community of experts, tools and resources to grow their practices, and an unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality consumer healthcare experiences at scale. 
 Job Summary: 
 The Business Operations Manager supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational standards across the organization’s hospitals. Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, this role focuses on executing initiatives, supporting hospital leaders, coordinating cross-functional projects, and helping translate strategic priorities into practical, scalable processes. 
 This position plays a hands-on role in rollout execution, performance optimization, vendor coordination, and new hospital readiness. The Business Operations Manager partners closely with hospitals and cross functional teams to ensure operational consistency, adoption of new initiatives, and measurable improvements in efficiency and performance. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Hospital Operating Model Support 
 Supports the design, development, documentation, and refinement of the hospital operating model, including workflows, role clarity, and standard operating procedures. Help create new operational approaches and programs, such as the Lovet Essentials Plan (LEP) and upcoming model enhancements, which call for fresh thinking and creative solutions rather than just improving what already exists. Maintain best practices and assist with updates based on performance trends and field feedback. 
 Initiative Implementation & Rollout 
 Assist in planning, piloting, and executing new operational initiatives. Build project timelines, track milestones, coordinate stakeholders, and support hospital readiness to ensure successful adoption. 
 Hospital Support & Field Enablement 
 Partner with hospital leaders to address operational challenges, provide structured problem-solving support, and help implement standardized processes. Identify recurring issues and escalate themes to the Director as needed. 
 Vendor Coordination 
 Support vendor onboarding, implementation, and ongoing performance tracking. Help ensure vendor tools and services are integrated into hospital workflows and aligned with operational standards. 
 Cross-Functional Project Support 
 Coordinate with Field Operations, Finance, Clinical, IT, HR, Learning & Development, Marketing, and Data & Analytics teams to support execution of cross-functional initiatives and serve as a consulted subject matter expert. Partner with both Lovet and The Aspen Group (TAG) teams to ensure initiatives are aligned, resources are shared effectively, and hospitals receive consistent support. Track dependencies, maintain communication, and ensure alignment between corporate teams and hospitals. 
 Growth & Scalability Support 
 Assist in operational planning for expansion efforts and support the execution of growth for new Denovo hospitals. Contribute to building scalable processes that support multi-site consistency. 
 Product & Service Operationalization 
 Partner with clinical and leadership teams to support the creation and rollout of new offerings, such as the Lovet Essentials Plans, new products, and new vendor partnerships. Develop the supporting resources needed for successful adoption, including workflows, documentation, training coordination, and readiness tracking. 
 Operational Performance Optimization 
 Analyze hospital KPIs and operational data to identify improvement opportunities. Support implementation of scheduling, utilization, and workflow optimization efforts. 
 Change Management & Adoption 
 Support hospitals through operational changes by reinforcing expectations, tracking adoption, and helping troubleshoot barriers to implementation. 
 New Hospital Launch Support 
 Supports the planning and execution of new hospital openings, including readiness checklists, workflow setup, coordination with internal teams, and transition into ongoing operations. 
 Project Oversight Support 
 Assist in tracking project timelines, identifying risks, and ensuring smooth transition from project phase to operational ownership. 
 Client Billing & Revenue Support 
 Assists hospitals with Client billing support, client account reconciliation assistance, and client collections support and coordination. 
 Medical Advisory Committee (MAC) Facilitation 
 Partner with the Director of Business Operations and the Clinical Leadership team to plan and facilitate MAC meetings. Support agenda development, prepare meeting materials, document decisions and action items, and follow up with cross-functional teams to ensure MAC recommendations are communicated and implemented consistently across the network. 
 Pricing & System Updates 
 Price and product updates, process and procedure documentation, and code maintenance in our PIMS and system updates. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Successful execution and adoption of new initiatives improved operational consistency across hospitals, timely support for hospital leaders, accurate reporting and project tracking, creative solutions that move the organization forward, and well-coordinated new hospital launches that transition smoothly into stable operations. 
 Candidate must be local to the Phoenix, AZ area and have previous experience working as a Veterinary Hospital Manager. This position is primarily remote, but some travel will be required and time spent within hospitals on projects, rollouts, and supporting initiatives is expected.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong knowledge of medical terminology.
 Strong understanding of veterinary medicine and business principles.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Strong organizational and time management skills.
 Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
 Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
 7-15 years of experience in operations, veterinary medicine, multi-site, or similar environment
 Strong organizational and project coordination skills
 Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
 Analytical mindset with comfort interpreting operational

Work assignments will involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The ideal candidate is a natural orchestrator who loves bringing order to complexity. They can zoom out to understand strategic priorities, then zoom in to manage details that drive execution. They are comfortable leading without formal authority, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and keeping multiple moving pieces on track simultaneously. They thrive at creating clarity, accountability, and momentum that help teams perform at their best. 
 Job Description :
 Humana is a $100+ billion, Fortune 50, healthcare leader dedicated to improving the health and well-being of the people we serve. To help deliver on this mission, we are seeking a highly organized, strategic, and proactive Project Manager to lead the execution of an enterprise-wide priority initiative while serving as the operational hub for a growing Sponsorship & Experiential Center of Excellence (COE). This role acts as both the "quarterback" for key projects and the "air traffic controller" for the broader team, ensuring priorities, resources, timelines, and stakeholder communications remain aligned.
 The ideal candidate thrives in complex, cross-functional environments, brings rigor to project planning and governance, and can seamlessly move between strategic planning and day-to-day execution. Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, the ability to influence without authority, and a talent for bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity.

This role will make decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction.
